column3: Edit sends automation.update with only the changed fields, and the trigger set only when it changed (compared as create args), so saving a title never re-mints schedules or touches a webhook URL
column4: triggers replaces the whole set; resending an untouched set would re-create schedule rows for nothing. Two designs: always send everything, or diff against the loaded automation
